text: At baseline, APOE4 microglia showed higher LysoTracker signal (an acidotropic dye) than APOE3 microglia; the authors interpret this as increased lysosomal mass.
description: Primary microglia from APOE3 and APOE4 targeted-replacement neonatal mice; 100 nM LysoTracker Red DND-99 for 30 min, flow cytometry; n = 4 independent experiments (litters) per group; serum-starved cells as positive control. Caveat: LysoTracker reflects both compartment mass and acidity, so it is not a pH measurement; mouse microglia, not human astrocytes.

provenance.excerpt: f) The mass of lysosomes within microglia was quantified by measuring the gMFI of LysoTracker dye by flow cytometry, one-way ANOVA main effect of APOE genotype: F(2, 9) = 93.6, p = 9.5 x 10-07 followed by Tukey’s post-hoc corrected t-test E4 vs E3: p.adj = 0.01, d = 6.1 CI95% [2.5, 9.8].

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (higher LysoTracker acidic-compartment signal in microglia at baseline)

measured.variable: LysoTracker Red DND-99 gMFI (acidic compartment signal; interpreted by authors as lysosomal mass)
